command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
[ -f "$change/proposal.md" ] || { echo "$record names change '$change_name', but $change/proposal.md does not exist - write the change there, or name the active change the task is about"; exit 1; }
verdict=$(sed -n 's/^Verdict:[[:space:]]*//p' "$record" | head -1)
if [ "$verdict" != "no-blocking-dependencies" ]; then
  echo "the change record's verdict is '$verdict'; the only verdict that finishes this stage is 'no-blocking-dependencies'."
  echo "If the change IS blocked, do not finish the round: write the dependency chain to the path in \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE as {\"question\": \"...\", \"options\": [\"...\"]}, delete $record and end your turn."
  exit 1
fi

findings.message: FR4 focus/selection is tested only in jsdom: task 8.1 puts 'A failed copy selects the text' (field «Текст встречи» has the focus and its whole text is selected) into the vitest-cucumber feature grid_view_meeting_share_unit.feature, and task 9.1's E2E list has no failed-copy scenario. .claude/rules/bdd-unit.md: 'aria-labels, focus management | Unit BDD: no | E2E BDD: yes'; bdd-e2e/gherkin.md: 'If a scenario requires a real browser (focus, aria, layout), it goes into *_e2e.feature'. Add an E2E scenario (e.g. with the existing step 'a browser without a system share and without clipboard access') that checks the status, the focus on the field and window.getSelection() equal to the text.

The glossary term **Text sharing** in docs/glossary/architecture.md:13 ('the port that hands a text to the system share or copies it, answering shared, cancelled, copied or failed. Code: TextSharing, ShareOutcome, browserTextSharing, createInMemoryTextSharing') changes meaning under D1 (canShareText/shareText/copyText, no fallback from share to copy), but neither proposal 'What Changes' nor task 1.1 updates it. .claude/rules/glossary.md: 'A change that shifts a term's meaning, owner or Russian name updates the entry in the same change.'

FR2 and grid-view 'Meeting share dialog' promise the text is shown 'without inner scrolling for a list of up to 10 locations', but every planned test (tasks 8.1, 9.1, 'The dialog fits') uses the 4-location sample meeting; no task checks 10 locations. .claude/rules/test-planning.md: 'Every FR/NFR/UX from proposal must have at least one automated test covering it.' Add a 10-location case to the NFR-R1/FR2 E2E check (scrollHeight <= clientHeight), or drop the promise.
